events.title: MEXC began operating
events.description: MEXC began operating as a centralized cryptocurrency exchange in 2018.
events.notes: Year-level launch marker because the official company page states the operating year without an exact public day.

events.title: Hong Kong's SFC warned against unlicensed MEXC activity
events.description: Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission warned that MEXC was actively promoting virtual-asset trading services to Hong Kong investors without a licence application and added it to the Suspicious Virtual Asset Trading Platforms Alert List.
events.notes: The warning was jurisdiction-specific and did not establish a global shutdown or alter MEXC's active entity status.

events.title: FinCEN issued order restricting MEXC-related funds transfers
events.description: The U.S. Financial Crimes Enforcement Network issued an order restricting certain transfers involving MEXC Global by covered financial institutions. The order was published on November 10 and takes effect on December 10, 2026. MEXC stated on November 7 that its platform continued operating and that it had begun an independent review of AML and sanctions controls.
events.notes: The order is jurisdiction- and institution-specific; applicability includes covered institutions and specified MEXC Global entities. It does not establish global exchange closure or prove customer asset losses. Effective date is scheduled, not yet reached.
